issues.message: Drawn for the decoration step, not built: minecraft:water.
1412 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
12 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.

notes.purpose: No hospital sign at all on L1: from outside it is a plain two-storey timber house; only the rows of red beds seen from above show a ward.
notes.detail: Exterior is bare: tiny single-pane windows in big plaster and stone panels, no sills, boxes, lanterns or props outside.
notes.roof: One even spruce ring round the courtyard, a single colour; the 'cross gable over the door' is only a small notch with a pane at (8,9,1), not a real gable.
notes.shape: Reads as a large cube; the chimney is the only break.

visual.summary: The shell: a two-storey stone and half-timbered cloister hospital round a courtyard, with 14 beds, dispensary, healers' room, herb store, clay room and stairs.
problems: No red cross / healing sign on L1. Build the red cross in blocks on the upper storey over the door (as the infirmary v4 does with red_wool on white_wool), since banner patterns can't be stored and the banner shows plain white: e.g. red_wool at (8,5,1),(8,6,1),(8,7,1),(7,6,1),(9,6,1) with white_wool at (7,5,1),(9,5,1),(7,7,1),(9,7,1), replacing the posts at x7/x9 y5..7 and the pane at (8,6,1); keep it on every level, and move the banner at (8,7,0) so it doesn't cover the cross.
Front cross gable is too small to read (only the pane at (8,9,1) and stairs around it): give it a real gable face projecting from the front roof slope over the door.
Exterior bare: add window sills or trapdoor shutters and a lantern by the door already on L1, or larger windows in the wide plaster bays (x2..4 and x12..14, y5..7, z1).
Reach: 314 of 564 reached; unreached are roof slopes, eaves, attic beam tops and chimney ledges: fine (upper floor and courtyard are reached).

notes.roof: Front gable now a real 9-wide plaster face with a window and dark oak hips/verges; but the rest is still one even spruce ring round the courtyard with a plain hipped back (top view reads as a uniform square donut).
notes.purpose: Red wool cross on white wool over the door reads clearly from the front on every level (last round's main problem fixed).
notes.detail: Shutters, planters, bushes and taller windows fixed last round's bare front; back still plain.

visual.summary: Cloister hospital shell: stone brick ground storey, white plaster in dark oak frame above, red-wool cross over the door, front gable, chimney, two-tall shuttered windows and poppy planters with trapdoor fronts.
problems: Roof: the back and side slopes are one plain even spruce ring; break it with a small dormer or a back gable (e.g. over the back wall centre x7..9, z18) so it is not a uniform square donut from above and behind.
Back wall bottom storey is a wide blank stone brick stretch between the windows (x5..11, y1..3, z18): add a window, back door or buttress/log pile.

Reach: about 345 of ~650 standing places reached; unreached are roof slopes, eaves, ridge, attic beam tops (white_terracotta x5/x11 y8) and furniture/chimney ledges: fine (both floors and the courtyard are reached).
